1  IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA  CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CRIMINAL

APPEAL No.________ OF 2026  (Arising out of SLP(Criminal) No.10735/2025)
 BISWAJIT MONDAL   VERSUS  THE STATE OF WEST BENGAL   O R D E R 1.
Leave granted.

2. The appellant/accused stands convicted concurrently by the Trial Court as also by the High Court for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 306 read with Section 34 Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereinafter referred to as IPC) and was sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 02 years with a fine of Rs.2,000/- and rigorous imprisonment for 7 years with a fine of Rs.5,000/-
respectively for each of the offences.
3. Appellants wife, Amrita Hazra, committed suicide on 18.06.2017.
Although, initially, charge subsequently, the Trial Court found the appellants, A-1 and A-2 (Biswajit Mondal and Smt. Lakshi Mondal), guilty of committing offence punishable under Section 306 of IPC.

4. Upon hearing learned counsel for the parties at length and on a perusal of the judgment rendered by the Trial Court as also by the High Court, together with the evidence adduced by the prosecution,
we are satisfied that there is abundance of evidence against the appellant which would amount to commission of abetment to commit suicide as, by their act of torture, the deceased was driven to commit suicide.
5. Thus, we are not inclined to interfere with the conviction on merits.

sentences.text: At the same time, it is to be seen that the appellant was under incarceration from 18.06.2017 to 13.10.2018 (01 year 3 Month, 27 Days), thereafter, from 19.12.2022 to 19.12.2022 (1 day) & from 20.12.2022 to till date (3 years 01 month) and thus, has already suffered jail sentence for about 04 years and six months.
The total jail sentence awarded to the appellant is rigorous imprisonment for 07 years.
Thus, with remission, the appellant would have completed more than 05 years of incarceration.
7. Considering the entire fact situation of the case, we are inclined to reduce the sentence imposed upon the appellant to the period already undergone by him.
8. Accordingly, it is directed that the appellant be released forthwith, if not required in any other case.
9. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed partly.
10. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand closed.
